card.provider: Ethereum blobs (EIP-4844) as a storage layer
card.summary: No free tier. Live cost at time of check: $0.012 per MB as blobs (vs $8.74/MB as calldata). 128 KB per blob package, separate blob fee market.

record.provider: Ethereum blobs (EIP-4844) as a storage layer

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Live cost at time of check: $0.012 per MB as blobs (vs $8.74/MB as calldata). 128 KB per blob package, separate blob fee market.

retention.stated: ~18-day retention; per-block blob count cap; cost floats with the blob fee market.

egress.terms: Free to read while data exists, but data is pruned by consensus nodes after ~18 days. Retrieval after that depends on third-party archival indexers (Blobscan etc.), not on Ethereum.

record.tooling: blobkit.org (TypeScript SDK for blob transactions), Blobscan API, standard Ethereum JSON-RPC.
record.chaining: Multiply cost, not capacity: 10 TiB/month = 10,485,760 MB x $0.012 = ~$125,800/month, and the data expires in 18 days regardless of payment.
record.limits_note: ~18-day retention; per-block blob count cap; cost floats with the blob fee market.
record.reliability_note: Data is intentionally ephemeral by protocol design. The network is built to forget it after the DA window.

evidence.proved: 'At 14:49 UTC, posting 1 MB costs ... $0.012 on Ethereum blobs'; 'kept for about 18 days'; 'About 887 times cheaper ... than calldata'

evidence.quote: At 11:27 UTC, posting 1 MB costs $0.00015 on Avail, $0.0016 on NEAR DA, $0.012 on Ethereum blobs, $0.013 on Celestia.

evidence.proved: a blob is a 128 KB package of data
evidence.quote: A blob is a 128 KB package of data that a rollup attaches to an Ethereum transaction, added by EIP-4844 in March 2024.

evidence.proved: blobs are pruned after about 18 days
evidence.quote: Blobs have their own fee market and are pruned after about 18 days, while calldata is kept forever and priced as execution gas.

record.provider: ethstorage / evmfs / on-chain calldata file systems

free_tier.stated: None. Files are stored on-chain in FlatDirectory contracts, billed per transaction with calldata or blob upload types; the DA comparison page prices calldata at 9.98 USD per MB.

record.reliability_note: Real systems (EthStorage mainnet chain 333, FlatDirectory contracts; EVMFS 20 KB chunks per call) but pricing is per-calldata-byte. Calldata is $11.01/MB live. 10 TiB would be ~$115 million.
